analogy.rationale: Adrenergic receptors are Gs/Gi-coupled GPCRs that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so adrenergic agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; other GPCR agonist classes acting on similarly low-expressed receptors would also be weak, while the antagonist class shares the receptor but opposite signaling.
